security_analysis.title: Security Analysis Report
security_analysis.plain_language: A comprehensive security report that combines all security signals — MFA status, admin roles, sign-in patterns, and risk scores — into one actionable document.
common_issues: Multiple critical findings across MFA and admin roles
recommended_actions: Run security analysis monthly at minimum
Share report with IT team for action planning

combined_risk_scoring.title: Combined User Risk Scoring
combined_risk_scoring.plain_language: Risk score combines multiple signals: MFA status, admin privileges, sign-in patterns, and Entra risk flags to give each user an overall risk level.
common_issues: Users with no MFA and admin access are critical risk
High sign-in failure rates may indicate brute force attempts
recommended_actions: Require MFA for all HIGH risk users within 48 hours
Review and block legacy authentication for MEDIUM risk users

admin_roles.title: Administrator Role Management
admin_roles.plain_language: Admin roles give users elevated access to manage Microsoft 365. Too many admins, especially Global Administrators, increases security risk.
common_issues: Stale admin assignments not reviewed regularly
recommended_actions: Limit Global Administrators to maximum 3 accounts
Use specific roles instead of Global Admin where possible
Ensure all admins have MFA registered

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.plain_language: An additional identity check beyond a password.
recommended_actions: Track registration and provide recovery support

conditional_access.title: Conditional Access
conditional_access.plain_language: Policies that evaluate signals and apply access controls.
recommended_actions: Review exclusions and enforce appropriate controls

identity_protection.title: Identity Protection
identity_protection.plain_language: Detection and response for risky users and sign-ins.

risky_users.title: Risky users
risky_users.plain_language: Accounts Microsoft detects as potentially compromised.

legacy_authentication.title: Legacy authentication
legacy_authentication.plain_language: Older protocols that may not support modern protections.

password_policy.title: Password policy
password_policy.plain_language: Rules for password length, reuse, and account recovery.
recommended_actions: Use strong password and lockout controls

privileged_roles.title: Privileged roles
privileged_roles.plain_language: Administrative roles with authority over identity or services.

guest_users.title: Guest users
guest_users.plain_language: External identities invited to collaborate in the tenant.

sign_in_logs.title: Sign-in logs
sign_in_logs.plain_language: Records of authentication attempts and their outcomes.
